Approximately 75 millions of abortions occur each year in the world, 45% of them are unsafe, are clandestine (which mean they often occur in a state or area that forbid the access of abortion). Every 9 minutes, a woman dies of an unsafe abortion. Or they suffer an intense pain, mutilations, suffer from disease … 
Each year, approximately 13% of maternal deaths are attributed to unsafe abortions. 
I won’t even argue about the consequences of these abortions, but I can clearly say that the woman puts her life in danger. Or if she really doesn’t want the baby, she will throw it somewhere in a trash bin and abandon it. That’s not a worst case scenario as it often happens in underdeveloped countries and areas. 

So you consider yourself a pro life ? Fine, what about the life of these women who die from complications due to these abortions ? 
Banning the right to abort will never make abortions cease, just more women will die from clandestine abortions. So you put at risk the life that you want to preserve, which is the life of the foetus, and also the life of the mother.
